title: Autovent V4
features:
A FULL FUNCTIONAL AUTOFARM SCRIPT FOR THE ARSENAL'S NIGHT'S EDGE EVENT.

- Teleport To Color Codes
- Automize Codes
- Teleport To Milo/Clock
- Get your dev melee

This script started my career and i'm happy to release it here open sourced!
It has been showcased By Inno On YouTube (thx for the thumbnail)
but it was obfuscated.  There are so many worse versions of this, I will only upload the latest tho.

This script should work on ANY executor, but gun mods can be a lil annoying sometimes. I know this isn't the best script so feel free to shoot me a dm on discord with your improvements.
